# LTR-1 Create monorepo layout, Makefile and env example
State: Review | Priority: urgent | https://plan.broszio.com/prodsystem/projects/82be4761-aa94-4567-b7b9-c91e9da25449/issues/f0bb5f35-1c79-4b24-ac3c-09ce364ff612/

Create the folder layout from architecture.md 'App structure': backend/, frontend/, infra/, docs/, .github/workflows/.

Add Makefile targets dev, test, lint, migrate, seed, e2e, eval (stubs allowed where the tool does not exist yet).

Add .env.example listing every variable named in architecture.md 'Environments, config, secrets'.

Extend .gitignore for Python, Node, Docker and local env files.

Acceptance


- ☐ make lint and make test run without error on the empty project

- ☐ .env.example contains DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL, S3_*, LETTERMAN_MASTER_KEY, SESSION_SECRET, DATA_REGION

- ☐ README.md explains how to start dev in three commands



Files (hint)


- Makefile

- .env.example

- .gitignore

- README.md

- backend/

- frontend/

- infra/
